paras: The Pestel amphisbaena (Amphisbaena leali) is a species of amphisbaenian in the family Amphisbaenidae. The species is endemic to Haiti.
The specific name, leali, is in honor of herpetologist Manuel Leal, co-collector of the holotype.
A. leali may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 25.4 cm (10.0 in). It is heavy-bodied, and its tail is relatively long for an amphisbaenian.
A. leali is found in the Haitian department of Grand'Anse.
The preferred natural habitat of A. leali is forest.
A. leali is terrestrial and fossorial.
